title: Episode 12: The Pig War of 1859: The Standoff Over a Rooting Hog
description: In June 1859, on San Juan Island in the Pacific Northwest borderlands of the Oregon Territory, an American settler shot a British Berkshire pig rooting in his potato patch. The dispute escalated into a military standoff with five British warships, 167 guns, and Captain George Pickett's American troops, nearly sparking war between global superpowers.
